entries.description: Swiss business software over MCP: clients, quotes, invoices with the QR bill, payments, expenses, documents, engagements, products, the books, the VAT return and key figures of one workspace. Authenticate with a personal API token.

List my unpaid invoices and record a payment
Prepare the Swiss VAT return from my books
Add an expense or a client to my Swiss business
